messages:
Alex R: Heads up — PR #5423 (cache key + ttl) is ready from my side. Local tests green. CI has been queued for ~2h though, looks like infra flake. Can we coordinate a merge window? I'm heading into a short blackout in ~30m.

Maria T: If CI is stuck, a rebase to main usually clears the queue. Also this needs 2 approvals (eng + security). Quick sec check is fine — nothing risky afaict.

Samir: I can do the code review now, pinging for review. Shallow look: changes look small. @Maria T please do security glance and then I can approve.

Jin Park: FYI I won't be available during the deploy freeze 11:00-12:00 UTC. If you want this merged before freeze, we need green CI within ~25m. Otherwise hold until after.

release-bot: Deploy freeze scheduled 2025-02-12 11:00-12:00 UTC. Merges are discouraged during freeze.

Alex R: Plan proposal: 1) Maria rebases and pushes; 2) trigger CI rerun; 3) Samir approves if green; 4) merge only if CI finishes within 20m so we don't hit freeze. If CI still queued after 20m, we hold. Can someone press /retest or trigger a manual rerun if it stalls?

QA Bot: Flaky test detected: integration/test_cache_lookup failed twice in last 30m. Consider rerunning just integration suite.

Maria T: Doing the rebase now. Command I'm running: 
```
git checkout pr/5423
git pull --rebase origin main
# resolve tiny conflict in pkg/cache/index.go
git push --force-with-lease
```
Should be done in ~5m.

Samir: Thanks — will stand by to review. If you push, @me and I'll approve as soon as CI starts passing. Also remind: avoid merging within 1h of the canary deploy at 13:00 UTC.

Alex R: Rebased and force-pushed. Triggered CI rerun via the UI: https://ci.internal/redwood/builds/12345 (integration-suite first).

release-bot: CI status for PR #5423: queued -> running -> failed (integration/test_cache_lookup).

Jin Park: Looks like the same flaky test. @QA Bot can you rerun only integration?

QA Bot: Rerun triggered: /rerun-integration for PR #5423.

Maria T: I also pushed a tiny TODO in the test to guard a timing race — shouldn't affect behavior but may reduce flakiness. Pushed at sha abc1234.

Samir: LGTM on code, and I see the change to tests. Approving now; will wait for successful CI to hit merge.

Alex R: If the rerun is green within 20m we merge before freeze. If it still flakes, we hold and schedule a follow-up tomorrow in the rebase window (first 30m after main cut). Also I'll coordinate with release ops for an explicit opt-in if needed during freeze.

Samir: :thumbsup:

Maria T: Security note — updated commit message with "no credential changes" line per checklist. Good to go from my side.

QA Bot: Integration rerun passed (integration-suite).

release-bot: CI status for PR #5423: passed. No active deploy freeze.

Alex R: Merged at 1749001290. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. If any regressions show up, I'll revert and file an incident.

Samir: Nice, thanks!

Jin Park: Great, thanks — avoids hitting the freeze.
